ISRO URSC Apprentice Online form 2026 - Complete Details

ISRO URSC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 के लिए 410 पदों पर ऑनलाइन आवेदन शुरू। Graduate, Diploma एवं Commercial Practice Apprentice भर्ती की योग्यता, आयु सीमा, चयन प्रक्रिया, महत्वपूर्ण तिथियां और आवेदन प्रक्रिया यहां देखें।

Application Fee

  • Computer Science Engineering : 40
  • Industrial Engineering : 10
  • Computer Science Engineering : 30
  • Instrumentation Technology Engineering : 05

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
